podcast.body: This song by an all-female group, released in 1979 on Sugar Hill Records, is highlighted as another important early rap release. The speaker suggests that such tracks by women could easily have been credited with marking the genre's beginnings, emphasizing the overlooked contributions of female artists. "el mismo año en 1979 también en la discográfica su ágil de sequence esa banda de mujeres acaba fangio."
